look_here_first: Delicate upright-to-sprawling annual with yellow-orange flowers and round to ellipsoid inflated capsules on straight or slightly curved pedicels.

key_traits.label: Family pattern
key_traits.text: Brassicaceae bladderpod group: 4-petaled yellow flowers, stellate hairs common, and inflated silicles/capsules; habit, hair density, pedicel posture, and fruit shape are important for ID.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: stem leaves narrow and often sessile

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: fruiting pedicels straight to slightly curved

lookalikes.differences: More open and wiry than low dense P. densiflora. Fruit is inflated but the plant usually looks taller, looser, and more sprawling.
